records.title: A placebo-controlled study of an herbal compound used for management of lower urinary tract disease in healthy cats
records.authors: Martin CE, Bartges JW, English CF, et al.
records.population_outcome_label: Healthy cats · urine or hydration measurements
records.support: Double-masked randomized crossover: seven healthy males enrolled, six analyzed. Herbal compound lowered struvite RSS; urine volume, pH and calcium oxalate RSS did not significantly differ.
records.limitations: Healthy non-stone-formers, multiple endpoints and one-tailed RSS/volume tests. No demonstrated clinical prevention, analgesia or FIC treatment; long-term safety unknown.
